items.question: 2018 年每个月的订单量相比 2017 年同期增长了多少？
items.goldSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS yr,
         EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS mo,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM orders
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT cur.mo AS month,
       cur.cnt - prev.cnt AS yoy_change
FROM monthly cur
JOIN monthly prev ON prev.mo = cur.mo AND prev.yr = 2017
WHERE cur.yr = 2018
ORDER BY cur.mo;

items.question: 每个优惠券活动带来的有效订单数和商品销售额是多少？取前 10。
items.goldSql:
SELECT ca.campaign_name, COUNT(DISTINCT cu.order_id) AS used_orders, ROUND(SUM(oi.price), 2) AS gmv
FROM coupon_usages cu
JOIN coupons cp ON cp.coupon_id = cu.coupon_id
JOIN campaigns ca ON ca.campaign_id = cp.campaign_id
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = cu.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = cu.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY gmv DESC LIMIT 10;
items.actualSql:
SELECT x.campaign_name,
       COUNT(*) AS valid_orders,
       ROUND(SUM(COALESCE(os.sales, 0)), 2) AS sales
FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT ca.campaign_id, ca.campaign_name, cu.order_id
    FROM campaigns ca
    JOIN coupons c ON c.campaign_id = ca.campaign_id
    JOIN coupon_usages cu ON cu.coupon_id = c.coupon_id
    JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = cu.order_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
) x
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT order_id, SUM(price) AS sales
    FROM order_items
    GROUP BY order_id
) os ON os.order_id = x.order_id
GROUP BY x.campaign_id, x.campaign_name
ORDER BY sales DESC
LIMIT 10;

items.question: 首单在 2017 年上半年的用户，在 2017 年下半年是否再次下单？按月留存率是多少？
items.goldSql:
WITH first_order AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_ts
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY 1
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT customer_unique_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', first_ts)::date AS cohort_month
  FROM first_order
  WHERE first_ts >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND first_ts < DATE '2017-07-01'
),
returner AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.customer_unique_id, co.cohort_month
  FROM cohort co
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_unique_id = co.customer_unique_id
  JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-07-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01'
)
SELECT co.cohort_month,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(re.customer_unique_id) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct
FROM cohort co
LEFT JOIN returner re ON re.customer_unique_id = co.customer_unique_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

items.question: 优惠券带来的 GMV 和优惠金额分别是多少？用券订单的折扣率是多少？
items.goldSql:
SELECT ROUND(SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 2) AS gmv,
       ROUND(SUM(cu.discount_amount), 2) AS discount,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(cu.discount_amount) / SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value), 2) AS discount_pct
FROM coupon_usages cu
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = cu.order_id
JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = cu.order_id
WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable');
items.actualSql: WITH coupon_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(discount_amount) AS discount_amount FROM coupon_usages GROUP BY order_id), order_totals AS (SELECT order_id, SUM(price + freight_value) AS order_gmv FROM order_items GROUP BY order_id) SELECT ROUND(SUM(ot.order_gmv), 2) AS gmv, ROUND(SUM(ct.discount_amount), 2) AS discount_amount, ROUND(100.0 * SUM(ct.discount_amount) / NULLIF(SUM(ot.order_gmv), 0), 2) AS discount_rate FROM coupon_totals ct JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ct.order_id JOIN order_totals ot ON ot.order_id = ct.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') LIMIT 201

items.question: 2017 年和 2018 年各月 GMV 分别是多少？并计算 2018 年相对 2017 年同月的同比增长率。
items.goldSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS yr,
         EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS mo,
         SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT m18.mo,
       ROUND(m17.gmv, 2) AS gmv_2017,
       ROUND(m18.gmv, 2) AS gmv_2018,
       ROUND(100.0 * (m18.gmv - m17.gmv) / m17.gmv, 2) AS yoy_pct
FROM monthly m18
JOIN monthly m17 ON m17.mo = m18.mo AND m17.yr = 2017
WHERE m18.yr = 2018
ORDER BY m18.mo;

SELECT sa.state AS addr_state, c.customer_state, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS orders
FROM shipping_addresses sa
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = sa.customer_id
JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
WHERE sa.is_default
GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY orders DESC LIMIT 20;
items.actualSql:
SELECT c.customer_state, sa.state AS default_shipping_state, COUNT(DISTINCT o.order_id) AS order_count
FROM orders o
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
JOIN LATERAL (
  SELECT s.state
  FROM shipping_addresses s
  WHERE s.customer_id = o.customer_id
    AND s.is_default = true
  ORDER BY s.address_id
  LIMIT 1

items.question: 首单在 2017 年上半年的用户，在 2017 年下半年是否再次下单？按月留存率是多少？
items.goldSql:
WITH first_order AS (
  SELECT c.customer_unique_id, MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_ts
  FROM orders o
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY 1
),
cohort AS (
  SELECT customer_unique_id, DATE_TRUNC('month', first_ts)::date AS cohort_month
  FROM first_order
  WHERE first_ts >= DATE '2017-01-01' AND first_ts < DATE '2017-07-01'
),
returner AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT co.customer_unique_id, co.cohort_month
  FROM cohort co
  JOIN customers c ON c.customer_unique_id = co.customer_unique_id
  JOIN orders o ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp >= DATE '2017-07-01'
    AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < DATE '2018-01-01'
)
SELECT co.cohort_month,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(re.customer_unique_id) / COUNT(*), 2) AS retention_pct
FROM cohort co
LEFT JOIN returner re ON re.customer_unique_id = co.customer_unique_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
items.actualSql:
WITH first_orders AS (
    SELECT
        c.customer_unique_id,
        MIN(o.order_purchase_timestamp) AS first_purchase_at
    FROM orders o
    JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
    GROUP BY c.customer_unique_id
),
cohorts AS (
    SELECT
        customer_unique_id,
        first_purchase_at,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', first_purchase_at) AS cohort_month
    FROM first_orders
    WHERE first_purchase_at >= TIMESTAMP '2017-01-01 00:00:00'
      AND first_purchase_at < TIMESTAMP '2017-07-01 00:00:00'
),
cohort_returns AS (
    SELECT
        co.customer_unique_id,
        co.cohort_month,
        EXISTS (
            SELECT 1
            FROM orders o2
            JOIN customers c2 ON c2.customer_id = o2.customer_id
            WHERE c2.customer_unique_id = co.customer_unique_id
              AND o2.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
              AND o2.order_purchase_timestamp >= TIMESTAMP '2017-07-01 00:00:00'
              AND o2.order_purchase_timestamp < TIMESTAMP '2018-01-01 00:00:00'
              AND o2.order_purchase_timestamp > co.first_purchase_at
        ) AS returned
    FROM cohorts co
)
SELECT
    cohort_month,
    ROUND(
        100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE returned) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0),
        2
    ) AS retention_rate
FROM cohort_returns
GROUP BY cohort_month
ORDER BY cohort_month
LIMIT 100;

items.question: 2017 年和 2018 年各月 GMV 分别是多少？并计算 2018 年相对 2017 年同月的同比增长率。
items.goldSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS yr,
         EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS mo,
         SUM(oi.price + oi.freight_value) AS gmv
  FROM orders o
  JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id
  WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable')
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT m18.mo,
       ROUND(m17.gmv, 2) AS gmv_2017,
       ROUND(m18.gmv, 2) AS gmv_2018,
       ROUND(100.0 * (m18.gmv - m17.gmv) / m17.gmv, 2) AS yoy_pct
FROM monthly m18
JOIN monthly m17 ON m17.mo = m18.mo AND m17.yr = 2017
WHERE m18.yr = 2018
ORDER BY m18.mo;

items.question: 退款原因与客户评分的关系：各退款原因对应的平均评分和低分率是多少？

SELECT r.reason_code,
       ROUND(AVG(rev.review_score), 2) AS avg_score,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rev.review_score <= 2) / COUNT(*), 2) AS low_score_pct
FROM refunds r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN order_reviews rev ON rev.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY low_score_pct DESC;
items.actualSql:
-- 各退款原因下，按评价记录去重后统计平均评分与低分率
WITH reason_reviews AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT r.reason_code, rev.review_id, rev.review_score
  FROM refunds r
  JOIN order_reviews rev ON rev.order_id = r.order_id
)
SELECT
  reason_code,
  ROUND(AVG(review_score), 2) AS avg_score,
  ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE review_score <= 2) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS low_score_rate
FROM reason_reviews
GROUP BY reason_code

items.question: 2018 年每个月的订单量相比 2017 年同期增长了多少？
items.goldSql:
WITH monthly AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS yr,
         EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::INT AS mo,
         COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM orders
  WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp) IN (2017, 2018)
  GROUP BY 1, 2
)
SELECT cur.mo AS month,
       cur.cnt - prev.cnt AS yoy_change
FROM monthly cur
JOIN monthly prev ON prev.mo = cur.mo AND prev.yr = 2017
WHERE cur.yr = 2018
ORDER BY cur.mo;
items.actualSql:
WITH monthly_counts AS (
  SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS month,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int = 2017) AS orders_2017,
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE EXTRACT(YEAR FROM order_purchase_timestamp)::int = 2018) AS orders_2018
  FROM orders
  WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01'
    AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2019-01-01'
  GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT month,
       orders_2017,
       orders_2018,
       orders_2018 - orders_2017 AS growth
FROM monthly_counts
WHERE orders_2018 > 0
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 12;

items.actualSql: WITH monthly AS (SELECT EXTRACT(MONTH FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int AS month, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int = 2017 THEN oi.price + oi.freight_value END) AS gmv_2017, SUM(CASE WHEN EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int = 2018 THEN oi.price + oi.freight_value END) AS gmv_2018 FROM orders o JOIN order_items oi ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.order_status NOT IN ('canceled', 'unavailable') AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM o.order_purchase_timestamp)::int IN (2017, 2018) GROUP BY 1) SELECT MONTH, ROUND(gmv_2017, 2) AS gmv_2017, ROUND(gmv_2018, 2) AS gmv_2018, ROUND(100.0 * (gmv_2018 - gmv_2017) / NULLIF(gmv_2017, 0), 2) AS yoy_growth_percent FROM monthly ORDER BY MONTH LIMIT 201

items.question: 退款原因与客户评分的关系：各退款原因对应的平均评分和低分率是多少？
items.goldSql:
SELECT r.reason_code,
       ROUND(AVG(rev.review_score), 2) AS avg_score,
       ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE rev.review_score <= 2) / COUNT(*), 2) AS low_score_pct
FROM refunds r
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN order_reviews rev ON rev.order_id = r.order_id
JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY low_score_pct DESC;
